verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents a centralized cap table that replaces spreadsheets. It covers preferred share issuance, authorized share settings, adding SAFEs, vesting, ESOP management, timelines and downloadable reports, plus stakeholder access controls and ASC 718 reporting. A community user confirms that transactions update the cap table in real time. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of share certificate issuance or tracking, documentation of auditor-specific access or reliance, and independent corroboration beyond one user anecdote.
